newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's D'Onofrio sets shr dividend.
newsitem.headline: Peru's D'Onofrio sets shr dividend.

text.p: Peru's largest ice cream and confectionery company D'Onofrio has approved a 21.41 percent share dividend from its 1996 profits, the Lima Stock Exchange's daily report said Friday.

The dividend corresponds to an increase in capital to 93.5 million soles from 77.0 million soles in the company's common shares and an increase to 22.4 million soles from 18.5 milllion soles for its labor shares, the report said.
The company has not announced a record or payout date for the dividend.

D'Onofrio's share price fell 10 percent Thursday to close at 1.08 soles after the firm reported net profits for the first half of the year of 51,200 soles, compared with 3.7 million soles in the same period last year.
The share price Friday was unchanged in early trade.
In April, Switzerland's Nestle SA bought 98.7 percent of the company.
